programme.title: Reaching for the Moon

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: En dag besöks den pensionerade bibliotekarien Joan Stanley av brittiska säkerhetstjänsten som arresterar henne för spioneri. Alla omkring Joan chockas av att denna stillsamma dam misstänks för att vara en av de mest inflytelserika spionerna i historien.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En orolig indianveteran bildar en exceptionell vänskap med en fransk psykoanalytiker när de försöker hitta botemedel mot deras lidande.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: Jack är en tidigare hyllad bästsäljande författare. Författarkarriären och hans äktenskap är i kris och därför åker han och hans fru Amanda till en glampingretreat i jakt på den gnista som skulle kunna få deras kärlek att börja glöda igen.

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home
programme.desc: Alla berättar sin version av vad som hände när Simone och Bryson gjorde slut, vilket avslöjar vad de tycker om varandra och prövar deras lojalitet.

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests
programme.desc: Loomis ser Cooper vid en Vipersmatch. Cooper tvingas lämna ifrån sig övervakningsfilmen från bråket mellan Vanessa och Kalinda. Hon erbjuder sig att lämna in den för att behålla jobbet, men får sparken när hon gör det.

programme.title: Games People Play: A Wing and A Prayer
programme.desc: Laila hamnar i en farlig situation. MJ hör rykten om att nån läcker uppgifter om familjen King. Vanessas familj hotas och hon bestämmer att det är dags att agera.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Bitch is Back
programme.desc: Laila gömmer sig, oförmögen att tillbringa natten ensam. Vanessa köper motvilligt en ny telefon till Laila, som snart får veta att Susie Q är död. Vanessa tvingas trösta henne, trots att hon knappt tål henne.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save
programme.desc: Kareem säger till Marcus att han inte kan leva i hans skugga och ber honom att få bli utköpt. Marcus betalar honom 250 000. Kareem och Quanisha åker till Jamal med en väska med pengar för att få honom att försvinna.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane ser fram emot en ångestfri helg men planerna går i stöpet när Mark ringer och ber henne om hjälp med hans föräldrar som är på besök. Avslöjanden under besöket tvingar Mark att göra en förändring.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Efter att Mary Janes affär har avslöjats tvingas hon inse att hon är mer intresserad än hon trott. Patricks fest för att fira nykterhet ger en bild av hur han en gång var.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2905
programme.desc: Louise och Simon har precis fått sitt första gemensamma barn, Milas. Louise har flyttat in i Simons stora hus tillsammans med sin son Vincent. Men med Louise följer också en stor skuld från tidigare.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2702
programme.desc: Salim från Herning drömmer om att bli reseguide eller kosmetisk sjuksköterska. När Salim kom ut som homosexuell för sin muslimska familj började en fest som pågick i ett år, men nu har blivit pank.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2803
programme.desc: Rasmus vilda utgifter gör att han sitter fast i en lägenhet som han säger känns som ett fängelse. Men han kan inte gå vidare och få det liv han drömmer om förrän han slutar kasta pengar omkring sig.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2703
programme.desc: Camilla och Nis älskar att shoppa i Tyskland. Flera gånger i veckan kör de över gränsen för att handla läsk och godis. Samtidigt drömmer de om en bilresa.

programme.title: Klovn: Gottegrisen

programme.title: Klovn: Tipo Napoli

programme.title: Klovn: Känner Du Till Typen?

programme.title: Klovn: Mias Måne

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2622

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Double Circle

programme.title: MacGyver: The Road Not Taken

programme.title: MacGyver: Silent World
programme.desc: MacGyver and a deaf school teacher, Carrie Linden, live out a nightmare when they stumble upon an ex-CIA agent's ingenious plan to steal a missile, piece by piece, and sell it on the black market.

programme.title: MacGyver: Three for the Road
programme.desc: MacGyver battles the mob while protecting an elderly couple who have unwittingly become mixed up in a syndicate counterfeiting operation.

programme.title: MacGyver: Phoenix under Siege
programme.desc: Trapped inside the Phoenix Foundation by a group of terrorists, MacGyver races against a ticking bomb to save his life and that of his grandfather's.

programme.title: MacGyver: Family Matter

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 705

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 706
programme.desc: Mie och Jakob har flyttat in hos Jakobs mamma för att spara ihop till sitt drömhus. Men finns deras drömhus ens på marknaden? Tobias argumenterar för sin sak och Mie och Jakob får sig en chock.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 707
programme.desc: Både Kristina och Dennis familjer har flyttat till Odense och paret vill följa efter men kämpar att hitta tid för att gå på visningar. Vågar de satsa allt på experterna?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Värd Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna besöker Maiken och Michael i deras lilla lägenhet där de bor tillsammans med Michaels dotter. Snart blir de fyra och kan inte längre bo i lägenheten.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast: The Alchemist

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: A dying man's request to preserve a legacy for his young ward sends James T. West to Missouri, where he faces a wholesale conspiracy.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: An Army sergeant's letter to President Grant sends agents West and Gordon to a lonely outpost to fight a gang of terrorists.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: A tempestuous diva becomes involved in a New Orleans puzzle when kidnappers attempt to abduct her during a singing performance.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: An assignment to take possession of a priceless diamond for the National Museum takes James West to an eerie island estate.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: Secret agent West aids a Russian prince in recovering an all-important icon, sought also by a desperate, dangerous enemy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheating Secrets Revealed

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: My Pimp Runs My Family
programme.desc: Tracy and Allen have been living in a car. Her two older sisters are here to convince her to temporarily live with them and go back to school until he can provide for them.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Marrying a Transsexual!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Written in Blood

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Timothy Peart’s Last Dance

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Secret Life

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Highway

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert

programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Marrying a Transsexual!
programme.desc: Jerry is 58 years old and has had three big changes. He is currently happily engaged to a woman named Joy and speaks about his past gender confusion.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have Many Lovers
programme.desc: Today, Rufus comes clean about cheating on Treynae with Cheeta and Rhonda tells her girlfriend Lovette that she's in an affair with another woman! Who will choose whom?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wife Discovers Husband's Secret Family
programme.desc: Ron left Stacie when she was 8 months pregnant with his child for Audrey and thought he'd found his soul mate. Are Stacie's kids all his? Watch this classic showdown today!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Jerry Rescues An Obese Man
programme.desc: Denny weighs over 800 pounds and has been unable to leave his bed for the past 5 weeks and is ready to change his life. Today we follow Denny's courageous journey.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Woman In Labor Confronts Mistress
programme.desc: The first time Nancy, Tara and Versell appeared on the show, Nancy was pregnant with Versell's baby. He was cheating on her with Tara and now she's pregnant! Who will go?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Dear Santa
programme.desc: Jerry is joined by Santa and his elves to answer 7 very special Christmas letters from needy children. Watch these happy faces light up when their holiday wishes are granted!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Highway
programme.desc: One is dead and two are in critical condition, and it’s up to Kenda and Barry to find out why a gun battle occurred in a quaint family home.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Cradle to the Grave
programme.desc: A frantic 9-1-1 call from a daycare reports an infant found not breathing. After a medical examination reveals signs of child abuse, Kenda must discover who committed the heinous crime.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Point of No Return
programme.desc: When a mysterious explosion rocks a sleepy suburb, it’s up to Kenda to ID a pile of charred remains and find the killer who triggered the blast.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: A mother of two is found dead in the most expensive part of Colorado Springs, leaving Lt. Joe Kenda stumped—until he looks into her personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Fugitive Justice
programme.desc: Respected neurosurgeon Sam Sheppard is found guilty of brutally killing his wife, despite his pleas of innocence. His story captures a nation and becomes the basis for the hugely popular television series and film,

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: July 28, 1996. A bloated, decomposing corpse is hauled out of the English Channel. There is little to go on. Police don’t know whether this is a murder, a suicide, or just a tragic accident.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Killer Commando
programme.desc: Between 1980 and 1988 a triangle in Northeastern France becomes an unlikely field of prey for a serial killer. More than six soldiers are murdered, all with the same MO.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Family Secrets
programme.desc: On June 6, 1996, Darlie Routier places a panicked 911 call – her two young sons have been stabbed by an intruder. She herself has also been wounded.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Deadly Dance
programme.desc: If there's a theme to Shirley and Ed Andronowich's marriage it's getting drunk and then fighting. One evening, the same old plays out, but this time Shirley doesn't come home.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.title: iCarly: Återförening med Missy
programme.desc: När Carlys gamla kompis Missy flyttar tillbaks till Seattle, tror Sam att Missy försöker ersätta henne som Carlys bästa kompis.

programme.desc: Four men, aided by a guard named Foxx, gain entrance to the U.S. Mint in Carson City and connect a hose to a street gaslight in order to asphyxiate three workers.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: A man from the Attorney General's office in Washington is killed while attempting to take the wanted John Avery into custody, so secret agent James T.West is assigned to the task.

programme.title: The Wild Wild West
programme.desc: Traffic on the lower Mississippi River has come to a virtual standstill because of the marauding tactics of a blind pirate leader and his cutthroat gang.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clutch of Witnesses
programme.desc: Two eyewitnesses may hold the key to the death of a motorcycle gang member.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scout's Honor
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Dear Santa
programme.desc: Jerry is joined by Santa and his elves to answer 7 very special Christmas letters from needy children. Watch these happy faces light up when their holiday wishes are granted!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: You Won't Marry Your Gay Lover!
programme.desc: Friends and family refuse to accept same sex marriage! Martin won’t let his son marry his boyfriend. April wants her ex back, but he’s in love with a man! Who has the final say?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have A Secret For My Man!
programme.desc: Friends Tatiana and Latasha have both been keeping a big secret from their boyfriends! Today they're here to come clean!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'll Never Let You Go!
programme.desc: Chrishon denies he’s engaged to Taiwana with 3 weeks until their wedding. Lauren confronts her ex for leaving her for another woman while pregnant! Dave still wants Leesa’s love.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Honey… I'm a Call Girl!
programme.desc: Chloe and Dan will tie the knot soon, but she’s finally ready to tell him about her real job. Then, Amanda’s mom begs her to quit her job.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Sizzling Sex Secrets!
programme.desc: Torrance admits to cheating on his girlfriend with a shocking twist. Then, Heather wants her boyfriend’s ex Tramisha to stop interfering with their relationship.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood From A Stone
programme.desc: A bystander receives a deadly head injury during a roadside altercation, but the stakes are raised when his body disappears from the scene. When a toddler is kidnapped for ransom Kenda joins forces with an undercover team in a desperate race against time.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Instinct
programme.desc: When a drunken dispute at a biker bar turns deadly, Kenda must launch a manhunt for a pair of suspects who fled with a small boy in tow.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24-year-old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: Deadly Dance
programme.desc: If there's a theme to Shirley and Ed Andronowich's marriage it's getting drunk and then fighting. One evening, the same old plays out, but this time Shirley doesn't come home.

programme.title: True Crime Scene: High Rollers
programme.desc: One night, Las Vegas casino mogul, Ted Binion tells his lawyer: "Take Sandy out of the will, if she doesn't kill me tonight". Next morning, Binion shows up very dead and his girlfriend Sandy is the top suspect.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Prison Break
programme.desc: Young man breaks out of prison and manages to keep hidden for over a week. His reason for breaking out is that his ex-girlfriend has started dating his father again.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Footprints in the Snow
programme.desc: In the early morning hours on a dark and cold day the forensic officer of the Police force is called out to a break in at a garage. A few hours later he is called out again, but this time there is a dead body, brutally murdered, lying on the pavement.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Bloody Business
programme.desc: Two young men start a fashion shop together. Just a few days after they open, one of them disappears without a trace. He was well known in his community so everybody takes part of big search, even the person who knew what really happened.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: The Telecom Scandal
programme.desc: Three men manage to steal over 2 million dollars from the telephone company that is owned and run by the government. The money was used to open a new and yet today a respectful television station.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: A young girl loses her mind aboard an airplane from Copenhagen to Iceland. She is picked up by the police on arrival. But just after they find out she is to be sold to prostitution in Iceland, she is kidnapped again from where she was in custody.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillingar
programme.desc: Freddie försöker bevisa att Melanie, Sams tvillingsyster, bara är Sam som har klätt ut sig. Under tiden, när Carly undervisar Spencers fiende Chuck, försöker Spencer bevisa för Carly att Chuck är ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 2

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor

programme.title: iCarly: Snabbdejt
programme.desc: Det kommer så många killar till "Gå ut och dansa med Carly"-tävlingen att Carly, Sam och Freddie måste ha snabb-dejter för att hinna träffa dem alla. Spencer följer ett bisarrt träningsprogram från en ny Pearphone-app.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag fixar till en popstjärna
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie går med på att göra en musikvideo inför en popstjärnas comeback, upptäcker de att popstjärnan är ur form och saknar talang. Under tiden upptäcker Spencer att kvinnan han dejtar är Gibbys mamma.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two

programme.title: Boomerang: Game Night

programme.title: Boomerang: Power

programme.title: Games People Play: Pilot

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2604

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 606

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Kaos och avslut

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyles bestman James och geordiegrabbarna kommer till Ko Samui för Kyles svensexa men Nathan och tjejerna har släppt loss i Bangkok. Holly dyker upp men Sophie känner sig nere och de andra spekulerar i om det är på grund av osämjan med Marnie.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Efter en vild utekväll i Bangkok är Nathan och Chloe överens om att det är dags att dra till Ko Samui, där Holly är ensam tjej omgiven av sina ex. Familjen ser fram emot att återförenas men det blir jobbigt för Ricci när Chantelle kommer till huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyle och James konfronterar Jay och Ricci om varför de inte kom till Kyles förlovningsfest. Jay blir överrumplad och det uppstår spänningar. Och gänget kan inte fatta att Marnie dyker upp på svensexan, speciellt inte Sophie... Superjobbigt!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Where's the Beach
programme.desc: Sammi bestämmer sig för att sluta fred med Snooki och Deena. JWoww stöter på sin gamla kärlek Roger och det slår gnistor. Snooki anhålls för fylla på allmän plats.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Snooki
programme.desc: Efter att Snooki anhållits är hon deprimerad tills hon träffar en ny kille. Deena träffar Ronnies stuntman. Samtidigt gör JWoww och Tom slut.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Drunk Punch Love
programme.desc: Ronnie och JWoww sluter fred vilket leder till att Sammi ger Ronnie ett knytnävslag i ansiktet. Vinny träffar en tjej med en högdragen familj. Och Mike får reda på Deenas lilla fula hemlighet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Should We Just Break Up?
programme.desc: Ronnies överdrivna drickande orsakar smärtsamma sidoeffekter. Snooki träffar kille som kanske är förlovad... eller kanske inte. Pauly sluter fred med en gammal fiende.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 405
programme.desc: Mike, Ronnie, Sammi, Vinny och Deena diskuterar de första dramatiska och roliga avsnitten av den fjärde säsongen. Vi får veta allt om Deenas vilda strul och om grälet som gick rakt in i väggen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 407
programme.desc: Känslorna svallar när Snooki, Jenni, Deena och Mike samlas för att prata om Mikes påstådda strul med Snooki - för att inte tala om vad som hände när köttbullarna hamnade i säng tillsammans.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 409
programme.desc: Snooki, Jenni, Pauly och Vinny pratar om vad som hände efter det att Snooki och Jionni grälat hela natten - och så får vi en förhandstitt på vad som händer i resten av säsongen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Season 4 Reunion
programme.desc: Efter en sommar fylld av tömda och krossade flaskor, hjärtesorg, lesbioniska strul, bilolyckor och väggdramatik, samlas gänget för att strö salt i varandras sår och ta farväl av Florens.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Jump Split
programme.desc: Det är bara andra repetitionsveckan och Kelli och Judy är snabba med att gå igenom DCC-rörelserna med kandidaterna. Många av de nya kandidaterna har aldrig gjort ett spagathopp och deras brist på erfarenhet gör att några av flickorna skadar sig.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeover
programme.desc: Det är fjärde träningsveckan och utmanarna får en DCC-makeover. Under Kelli Finglass överinseende får tjejerna DCC-looken med nya frisyrer och och ny sminkning.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Week Five
programme.desc: Det är femte träningsveckan och Kelli är borta på grund av sjukdom. DCC:s tekniska ledare, Kitty Carter, hoppar in och leder veckans första repetition. Kitty är brutalt ärlig när hon påpekar att flera av tjejerna dansar slarvigt.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Final Cuts
programme.desc: Träningslägrets sjunde vecka börjar med en repetition på planen på Cowboys Stadium. Kelli och Judy är redo att göra de sista uttagningarna och kvällens repetition kan avgöra vilka som går vidare till truppen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Announcing the Squad
programme.desc: Det är dags att tillkännage DCC-truppen men först ser Kelli och Judy till att det blir en sista repetition ute på plan på Cowboys Stadium för kandidaterna. Tjejerna känner av pressen och Kelli och Judy har koll på dem.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: High Performance
programme.desc: Truppen har lagt sitt första matchdagframträdande bakom sig, men efter ett dåligt rep hotar Kelli med att hon kommer att skicka hem de som inte ger 110 procent.

programme.title: Mannen som talar med hundar: Buddy: Red Alert
